{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PaymentProcessor where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Aeson (Value(..), decode, encode)
import qualified Data.Aeson as Aeson
import qualified Data.Aeson.Key as Key
import qualified Data.Aeson.KeyMap as KM
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Network.HTTP.Client (Request, parseRequest, httpLbs, newManager, defaultManagerSettings, requestBody, RequestBody(..), method, requestHeaders, responseBody)
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, isSpace)
import Text.Read (readMaybe)

-- | Configuration for the payment gateway GraphQL endpoint
data GatewayConfig = GatewayConfig
  { gatewayUrl    :: String
  , apiKey        :: Text
  , merchantId    :: Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Represents a parsed payment upload from user
data PaymentUpload = PaymentUpload
  { puRecipient   :: Text
  , puAmount      :: Double
  , puCurrency    :: Text
  , puReference   :: Text
  , puMetadata    :: Maybe Text
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Sanitize text fields - removes obvious injection characters
sanitizeField :: Text -> Text
sanitizeField = T.filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == ' ' || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == '.')

-- | Validate currency code (ISO 4217)
validateCurrency :: Text -> Either Text Text
validateCurrency cur
  | T.length cur /= 3 = Left "Currency must be 3 characters"
  | T.all (\c -> c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') cur = Right cur
  | otherwise = Left "Currency must be uppercase letters"

-- | Validate amount is positive and reasonable
validateAmount :: Double -> Either Text Double
validateAmount amt
  | amt <= 0 = Left "Amount must be positive"
  | amt > 1000000 = Left "Amount exceeds maximum"
  | otherwise = Right amt

-- | Parse uploaded CSV line into PaymentUpload
parseUploadLine :: Text -> Either Text PaymentUpload
parseUploadLine line = do
  let fields = T.splitOn "," line
  when (length fields < 4) $ Left "Insufficient fields"
  let recipient = sanitizeField (fields !! 0)
      amountStr = fields !! 1
      currency  = T.strip (fields !! 2)
      reference = sanitizeField (fields !! 3)
      metadata  = if length fields > 4 then Just (fields !! 4) else Nothing
  amount <- maybe (Left "Invalid amount") Right (readMaybe (T.unpack amountStr))
  validatedAmt <- validateAmount amount
  validatedCur <- validateCurrency currency
  Right $ PaymentUpload recipient validatedAmt validatedCur reference metadata

-- | Build the GraphQL query fragment for a single payment
-- Uses parameterized approach for main fields
buildPaymentFragment :: PaymentUpload -> Text
buildPaymentFragment pu =
  let baseFragment = T.concat
        [ "{ recipient: \"", puRecipient pu, "\""
        , ", amount: ", T.pack (show (puAmount pu))
        , ", currency: \"", puCurrency pu, "\""
        , ", reference: \"", puReference pu, "\""
        , metadataFragment (puMetadata pu)
        , " }"
        ]
  in baseFragment

-- | Build metadata fragment - uses structured encoding for safety
metadataFragment :: Maybe Text -> Text
metadataFragment Nothing = ""
metadataFragment (Just meta) =
  let encoded = encodeMetadata meta
  in T.concat [", metadata: \"", encoded, "\""]

-- | Encode metadata - applies escaping transformation
-- Note: we apply sanitization then re-encode special display chars
encodeMetadata :: Text -> Text
encodeMetadata input =
  let step1 = T.replace "\\" "\\\\" input  -- escape backslashes first
      step2 = T.replace "\"" "\\\"" step1   -- escape quotes
      step3 = T.replace "\n" "\\n" step2     -- escape newlines
  in step3

-- | Build the full GraphQL mutation for batch payment processing
buildBatchMutation :: [PaymentUpload] -> Text -> Text
buildBatchMutation payments batchId =
  let fragments = map buildPaymentFragment payments
      paymentArray = T.intercalate ", " fragments
  in T.concat
    [ "mutation { processBatchPayment(batchId: \""
    , sanitizeField batchId
    , "\", payments: ["
    , paymentArray
    , "]) { id status confirmationCode } }"
    ]

-- | Process an uploaded payment file
processUpload :: GatewayConfig -> Text -> Text -> IO (Either Text Value)
processUpload config batchId content = do
  let linesRaw = T.lines content
      -- Skip header line
      dataLines = drop 1 linesRaw
  case mapM parseUploadLine dataLines of
    Left err -> return $ Left $ T.concat ["Parse error: ", err]
    Right payments -> do
      let mutation = buildBatchMutation payments batchId
      executeGraphQL config mutation

-- | Execute a GraphQL query against the payment gateway
executeGraphQL :: GatewayConfig -> Text -> IO (Either Text Value)
executeGraphQL config query = do
  manager <- newManager defaultManagerSettings
  initReq <- parseRequest (gatewayUrl config)
  let reqBody = encode $ Aeson.object
        [ (Key.fromText "query", String query) ]
      req = initReq
        { method = "POST"
        , requestBody = RequestBodyLBS reqBody
        , requestHeaders =
            [ ("Content-Type", "application/json")
            , ("Authorization", TE.encodeUtf8 $ T.concat ["Bearer ", apiKey config])
            , ("X-Merchant-Id", TE.encodeUtf8 $ merchantId config)
            ]
        }
  resp <- httpLbs req manager
  case decode (responseBody resp) of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Failed to parse gateway response"
    Just val -> return $ Right val
